title: Claimants
what: The claimants the rules declare: a task, a ticket or a process on the card begins a claim, the claim evicts and holds the card, and tasks that never reach the card give it back. In card/card.py.

title: The desktop rule
what: A person's desktop taking its card: NVML read once a second, five busy readings making the card the desktop's, the lock taken for it and given back once it is quiet. In card/desktop.py and card/card.py.

title: The hold
what: The node's queue of tickets: every occupant's turn in the occupants' order, the answers held open, giving way, resting, the ticket routes and the local holds. In card/card.py.

title: Lending
what: Lending the card to a borrowing engine over the inner network: the line protocol's hold, its turn following the engine's use, the rpc-server started for it and the pieces it fetches. In card/card.py.

title: Card lock and keeper
what: The shared flock every occupant takes the card by, held by the arbiter for a claim or the desktop, and the keeper that ends a holder with no place or one below a claim past the grace. In card/card.py.

title: Occupants
what: Who may be on the card and in what order: the node's occupants file, its ranks and wildcard, its history beside it, and the order read again within a second of a change. In card/card.py.

title: Turn client
what: The client an occupant in its own process uses: a ticket asked for and after, the turn waited for and the lock taken, a giving turn, a resting turn, and the command that holds a turn around another command. In card/turn.py.

title: Card units
what: The units in a card's memory, their owners and control sockets, unloading one whole into host memory or the dump store and loading it back, and the store's slots. In card/units.py.
